BOROUGH OF TESTLAND
ZONING ORDINANCE OF 2026
A fictional ordinance written for the VisionHousing tests. No real place.
ARTICLE I General Provisions
Section 101. Title
This Ordinance shall be known as the Testland Zoning Ordinance.
Section 102. Purpose
This Ordinance provides for residential housing of various dwelling types.
ARTICLE III Residential Districts
Section 301. R-1 Low Density Residential District
A. Uses permitted by right: single-family detached dwellings; agriculture; parks.
B. Area and bulk regulations: minimum lot area of 12,000 square feet; minimum lot
width of 80 feet; maximum height of 35 feet.
Section 302. R-2 Medium Density Residential District
A. Uses permitted by right: single-family detached dwellings; two-family dwellings;
townhouse dwellings of up to six units in a row.
B. Area and bulk regulations: minimum lot area of 6,000 square feet per dwelling.
Section 303. R-3 High Density Residential District
A. Uses permitted by right: apartment buildings; townhouse dwellings.
B. Area and bulk regulations: minimum lot size: 1 acre for each apartment building.
ARTICLE V Supplemental Regulations
Section 504. Accessory Dwelling Units
A. One accessory dwelling unit is permitted by right on any lot in the R-1 and R-2
districts that holds a single-family detached dwelling.
B. The accessory dwelling unit may be detached from the principal dwelling or
located within it.
C. The owner shall reside in either the principal dwelling or the accessory unit.
D. The accessory dwelling unit shall not exceed 800 square feet of floor area.
ARTICLE VII Off-Street Parking
Section 701. Off-Street Parking Requirements
A. Single-family detached dwellings: two parking spaces per dwelling unit.
B. Multi-family dwellings and apartment buildings: 1.5 parking spaces per dwelling unit.
C. Accessory dwelling units: no additional off-street parking is required.
ARTICLE IX Fees
Section 901. Fee Schedule
Fees for permits are set by resolution of Borough Council.
